text: The old trunk is hollow and ready to go. {lead} heaves, it topples, and out of the hollow rolls some loose change and a gratitude card.
A dead trunk, leaning on nothing much. {lead} puts its shoulder to it and over it goes with a crack. Underneath: Hazelnuts.
A gap in the wall, where the stones have gone for a walk. {lead} fits them back one by one, like a very slow jigsaw. Tucked in the wall behind: Pocket Transistor Radio.
The little round boat wobbles, then settles. {lead} crosses the water with short, careful strokes and lands among the reeds. There is Selkie Pearl.
